title: Versioned modeler-carrier truth and stale peer-writer readiness
mode: Primary-source web review and local parity-plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile Autodesk's type-specific DXF modeler record shapes and soft-owner reference semantics
Separate SAT/SAB inner-format compatibility from DWG and DXF outer-carrier framing
Refresh open ACadSharp and released LibreDWG evidence without treating branch claims as support or local defects
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 implementation readiness and fast validation ordering

sources.observed: The published 3DSOLID and REGION records both use the AcDbModelerGeometry subclass, group 70 and proprietary group-1/group-3 data; the 3DSOLID table additionally documents AcDb3dSolid and group 350 history ID. The ObjectARX group-code table classifies 350-359 as soft ownership, distinct from hard ownership.

ODA's DWG specification documents the AcDs container and SAB envelope while stating detailed SAB encoding is outside scope. ODA's Teigha note describes AutoCAD-modified SAT/SAB versions from 20800 as not directly usable by native Spatial ACIS without conversion.

The docs map DXF R2000-R2010 to SAT and R2013+ to SAB, expose raw carrier browsing, warn that ACIS entity support is limited and unsupported records may be lost, and describe mesh projection that loses curved-boundary faces.

The release notes describe the R2013+ AcDsPrototype_1b datastore as not yet reliably parsed and report brute-force extraction of new SAB blobs; they also report SAB-v2 conversion to legacy encrypted SAT-v1 for pre-R2013 DXF.

#1195 reports silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission in ACadSharp 3.4.9. #1240 is open and has no deployment on the reviewed page. #1150 describes version-specific DXF/DWG carriers, token-aware SAT grouping, a reported 2007 subclass boundary, and an Oct. 1 reader-refactor conflict; the maintainer acknowledged a fix in #1268 and preferred a schema-driven writer. These are mutable peer reports, not independently reproduced results or normative format facts.

localEvidence: Existing PAR-07/S8 work already separates older inline modeler payloads, modern DXF/DWG ACDSDATA or AcDs carriers, bounded section parsing, entity-owner linkage, and optional semantic/native gates.
Current local output dispatch includes DRW_ModelerGeometry handling; the plan already requires independent source-to-output inventory and fail-closed outcomes for unsupported profiles.
No new local defect, missing owner, or changed test requirement was established; this pass sharpens existing type/version/ownership cases and guards against cross-profile ACIS assumptions.
Findings/subplans remain 139/77; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8 modeler carrier capture, writer replay and semantic qualification
Existing source-to-output loss ledger and LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 2D contract
planImpact.readiness: Keep REGION and 3DSOLID schemas distinct; treat group 350 as soft ownership; preserve source/target and inner ACIS profile identity; test complete repeated chunks and sentinels; require an explicit translator for cross-profile conversion; qualify independent parser, kernel metrics and native consumer only as composed external gates.

method.kind: Review primary documentation, live peer issue/PR pages and release notes, then reconcile claims with the existing local plan
method.limitations: Peer issues and PR branches are mutable. The ACadSharp reports and PR validation were not reproduced; ODA is authoritative for DWG container layout but explicitly not a complete ACIS grammar; documentation scope does not guarantee behavior of arbitrary downstream binaries.
